deduped_findings.title: Article deep link returns 404 on production
deduped_findings.observation: Navigating to /reader/article/openai-models-weekly-briefing-513f843668 returns a 404 page. The deep link is documented and referenced from other surfaces.
deduped_findings.impact: Users following article links (from search, topics, notifications, or external) land on a dead page. Breaks core deep linking contract for the reader.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Restore the article route or implement a graceful fallback/redirect. If the article slug is ephemeral, surface a 'not available' state with link back to reader or search instead of a hard 404.

deduped_findings.title: Pressing '?' does not open keyboard shortcuts sheet
deduped_findings.observation: The reader UI advertises 'Press ? for keyboard shortcuts'. Pressing '?' triggers live refresh but does not open the ReaderShortcutsSheet. No 'Keyboard shortcuts' heading present in DOM after keypress.
deduped_findings.impact: Advertised discoverability feature is non-functional on production. Users cannot discover keyboard shortcuts via the documented gesture. Breaks parity with tests and documented UX.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Ensure useReaderShortcutHandlers is mounted for reader empty and loaded states, and that listReaderShortcuts() + Sheet render path is reached.

deduped_findings.title: Nav active state incorrect on home route
deduped_findings.observation: On the home page (/), the 'Reader' nav link has data-active="true" while the 'Home' link has data-active="false". This causes the wrong nav item to appear selected.
deduped_findings.impact: Users on the hub see 'Reader' highlighted as current location, creating confusion about where they are and breaking expected active-state semantics.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Set data-active="true" on the Home link when route is exactly '/'. Ensure Reader only active on /reader and subpaths.

deduped_findings.title: No site footer present
deduped_findings.observation: The page uses min-h-screen flex-col layout on body but contains no <footer> element. Scrolling to bottom reveals no footer content, links, or legal text. Dashboard also lacks footer.
deduped_findings.impact: Missing standard site chrome: no copyright, no secondary links (privacy, about), no visual page termination. Appears incomplete. Inconsistent chrome across surfaces.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Add a footer component with copyright, key secondary links, and consistent presence across all routes.

deduped_findings.title: Topic cards lack per-card 'Open in reader' quick actions (wave11 gap)
deduped_findings.observation: On /topics index and /topics/[topicId], each topic/source card is a single Link to the topic or source detail page. There is no secondary 'Open in reader' affordance on individual cards. A single 'Read topic' button exists at the topic detail header level only.
deduped_findings.impact: Users exploring topics must navigate to a detail page before reaching the reader. Discovery friction; inconsistent with search-results which surfaces 'Open in reader' for sources.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Add a compact 'Open in reader' secondary link or icon button on each topic card (index) and on source cards within a topic page, linking to /reader?topics=<id> or /reader?feed=<id>.

deduped_findings.title: Topic detail source cards have no reader handoff; only source page navigation
deduped_findings.observation: On /topics/agents, the 21 source cards link exclusively to /sources/* pages. The only reader entry is the header-level 'Read topic' button. No per-source quick entry to filtered reader.
deduped_findings.impact: Users who arrived via topic discovery cannot directly open a specific source in the reader from the topic page; must go through source detail or global reader.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Add an 'Open in reader' link on each source card within topic pages (or an icon button) that constructs /reader?feed=<sourceId>.

deduped_findings.title: Topics 'Read topic' on /topics/agents leads to /docs instead of reader
deduped_findings.observation: Clicking the 'Read topic' link from /topics/agents navigated to /docs (documentation page) rather than /reader with topic filter. The primary CTA does not handoff to reader as expected.
deduped_findings.impact: User journey from Topics/agents broken; users land in docs instead of content reader, confusing discovery flow.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Fix 'Read topic' link to target /reader?topics=agents (or appropriate filter). Ensure consistent handoff pattern matching search 'Continue in reader'.

deduped_findings.title: Docs sidebar too wide on mobile (331px on 390px viewport) crowding content
deduped_findings.observation: On 390x844 viewport, the docs sidebar (fumadocs aside) measures ~331.5px wide and remains visible or only partially overlays. Link count 13+ creates dense vertical list. Main content area is squeezed or pushed.
deduped_findings.impact: Mobile docs reading is impaired: insufficient space for prose, possible overlap, high tap density in sidebar. Poor mobile sidebar UX.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Configure fumadocs DocsLayout to use mobile drawer/overlay (sidebarOpen or collapsible). Hide sidebar by default on <768px and provide hamburger that slides in full or 80% width panel.

deduped_findings.title: Dark mode does not apply to blog surfaces; content remains light
deduped_findings.observation: Navigating to /blog and /blog/hub-and-blog and applying dark theme via class toggle + CSS variable injection leaves the main background and content cards in light beige/white with dark text. Only the hub nav bar appears dark.
deduped_findings.impact: Blog section breaks dark mode parity with the rest of the hub. Users who prefer dark see a jarring light content area when arriving from dark hub surfaces.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Ensure blog pages consume the theme-manager CSS variables (or Tailwind dark: variants) and that the root .dark class triggers full surface restyling.

deduped_findings.title: Load live sample click has inconsistent navigation outcome
deduped_findings.observation: Clicking 'Load live sample' (which calls refreshLatest(true)) sometimes remains on /reader and populates live posts with full reader chrome, and other times navigates to /search showing 'No matching articles found'.
deduped_findings.impact: Unpredictable UX. Users may expect in-place population of the reader desk; landing on search instead is disorienting and may make them think the action failed.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Make refreshLatest(true) strictly in-place for the reader route. Avoid any router.push/replace that takes the user out of the reader context.

deduped_findings.title: Command palette (⌘K) exists but discovery relies on button hint only
deduped_findings.observation: Pressing ⌘K opens a functional command palette dialog listing routes. However, the only visible hint is the 'Search ⌘K' button text. No other entry point or keyboard shortcut callout is prominent on the hub surface.
deduped_findings.impact: Power users may discover ⌘K, but casual visitors have no indication of keyboard navigation or quick route access beyond the visible nav.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Consider adding a subtle persistent hint (e.g., bottom-right 'Press ⌘K' toast or footer note) or ensure the command palette is mentioned in onboarding.

deduped_findings.title: Mobile nav uses 'Toggle Menu' chevron with no clear open state affordance on first tap
deduped_findings.observation: On 390px viewport, a 'Toggle Menu' button (chevron) appears in the header. Tapping it reveals additional nav items. The transition is subtle; no backdrop, label change, or expanded state indicator is immediately obvious.
deduped_findings.impact: Mobile users may not immediately understand the expanded state or how to dismiss the menu.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Add a backdrop/overlay on menu open, change chevron to X, or add aria-expanded visual change. Consider labeled 'Menu' text at smallest widths.

deduped_findings.title: Onboarding card overlays primary CTA area on first visit
deduped_findings.observation: A 'Welcome / Start reading in three steps' card with 'Got it' and 'Dismiss onboarding' appears on the hub, partially overlaying or competing with the primary 'Open reader' and secondary CTA grid.
deduped_findings.impact: First-time visitors see competing UI; the hero value prop and CTAs are de-emphasized until they dismiss onboarding.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Consider making the onboarding less intrusive (sidebar, inline steps, or collapsible) or auto-dismiss after first interaction with primary CTA.

deduped_findings.title: Corpus empty state renders filter controls (search, source type, topics)
deduped_findings.observation: On /reader with no corpus, the accessibility tree and HTML include: textbox 'Search posts', combobox 'Source type', combobox 'Add topic focus', and the 'Filters and view' group. Filters are not hidden.
deduped_findings.impact: Users see interactive-looking filter UI with no results and no clear indication that a 'Load live sample' step is required before filters are meaningful.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Either (a) keep filters visible but disable or visually de-emphasize until live sample is loaded, or (b) hide the advanced filter rail in the ReaderCorpusEmpty path.

deduped_findings.title: ArticleTeaser 'Open' link targets article page, not reader (handoff inconsistency)
deduped_findings.observation: Search results render ArticleTeaser components. The trailing 'Open' link navigates to getArticlePath (article detail page). There is a top-level 'Continue in reader' when a query exists, but no per-result reader entry.
deduped_findings.impact: Search discovery does not feed the reader directly per item. Users expecting 'search then read' must either use the coarse 'Continue in reader' or leave the search context.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Add a per-result 'Read in reader' action on ArticleTeaser (or search result items) that links to /reader with appropriate filters (q, source, etc.).

deduped_findings.title: Search 'Continue in reader' CTA uses identical surface styling to Search button
deduped_findings.observation: Both the form submit button and the 'Continue in reader' link (when query present) use: rounded-xl border border-(--line) bg-(--surface) px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium. They sit in adjacent surface-card containers.
deduped_findings.impact: Weak visual distinction between 'search again' and 'switch to reader'. Users may not perceive the intended handoff escalation.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Differentiate the handoff CTA: use primary/brand treatment, or an arrow icon, or place it as a prominent inline banner.

deduped_findings.title: Top nav 'Docs' link lacks active state indicator on /docs
deduped_findings.observation: When on /docs or /docs/*, none of the header nav items (including 'Docs') carry data-active="true" or aria-current. Home correctly marks active on /. Docs layout uses fumadocs + shared hub nav but active detection is not wired for docs subtree.
deduped_findings.impact: Breaks hub nav parity: user on docs does not see the current section highlighted in top chrome, inconsistent with Home/Reader surfaces.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Extend nav active logic (or fumadocs link props) to set data-active when pathname starts with '/docs'. Ensure 'Docs' is active for all doc subroutes.

deduped_findings.title: Docs page uses sidebar chrome breaking top-nav parity with home/reader
deduped_findings.observation: Navigating via header 'Docs' link lands on /docs which renders a sidebar layout ('Collapse Sidebar', docs TOC) and altered top nav. Header is not identical to / or /reader.
deduped_findings.impact: Inconsistent chrome across site; docs feels like separate app section, users lose context of global nav when in docs.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Align docs layout to share the same header/nav component as hub/reader/search. Make sidebar additional/collapsible without replacing primary chrome.

deduped_findings.title: Docs index content is thin; mostly links and headings, long vertical whitespace
deduped_findings.observation: The /docs landing renders a prose intro plus many anchor links and sections but limited visual cards or depth before the sidebar TOC. 'On this page' and main links feel list-heavy.
deduped_findings.impact: First impression of docs is sparse compared to hub surfaces. May not guide users strongly.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Add a quick-start card grid (Reader / Sources / Dashboard / CLI) or featured guide teasers at top of index.

deduped_findings.title: Mobile menu click fails with strict mode violation due to duplicate link roles/texts
deduped_findings.observation: After opening mobile menu, clicking nav links like Topics/Sources resolved to 2 elements (one sm:hidden in header, one in content). Click using @ref failed.
deduped_findings.impact: Unreliable mobile navigation in automation and potentially flaky UX if ARIA not unique.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Ensure unique accessible names or use more specific selectors/data attrs for mobile menu items. Add aria-hidden or distinct labels for duplicated links.

deduped_findings.title: Home nav link click from blog post page does not navigate
deduped_findings.observation: On /blog/hub-and-blog post, the header 'Home' link was present in snapshot, but clicking it resulted in no navigation (stayed on post). '← Back to all posts' worked correctly to /blog.
deduped_findings.impact: Broken expectation for hub nav from deep blog post; users must use back link or other.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Ensure all header nav links (esp Home) are fully functional on blog post pages. Check event handlers or next/link usage in post layout.

deduped_findings.title: 'Updates' label has low contrast on blog index header card
deduped_findings.observation: The small 'Updates' eyebrow label inside the first white surface card on /blog is rendered in a very light gray that has insufficient contrast against the white card background.
deduped_findings.impact: Low-priority label is hard to read; reduces visual hierarchy and polish.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Use a higher-contrast muted ink token (e.g., textSecondary or --ink-muted with sufficient contrast) for the Updates label.

deduped_findings.title: Post page immersive variant removes full hub chrome, creating visual discontinuity
deduped_findings.observation: The blog post page uses HubPage variant='immersive' (max-w-3xl) and renders a minimal '← Blog' back link in the header area instead of the full hub navigation.
deduped_findings.impact: Users experience a context shift when moving from hub or /blog index into a post; the disappearance of familiar nav chrome may feel like a different app section.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Consider keeping the standard hub top nav while still using a constrained reading container for content, or provide a subtle persistent nav affordance inside immersive mode.

deduped_findings.title: Search page empty state lacks visual affordance for the search input
deduped_findings.observation: Navigating to /search shows a search input and 'Search' button, but immediately displays 'No matching articles found' with suggestions. The input is not pre-focused and no example query chips are shown inline.
deduped_findings.impact: Users land on search with no guidance on what to type and an immediate negative empty-state message.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Auto-focus the query input on load, show example chips (e.g., 'llm', 'agents'), and soften the empty message to 'Enter a query to search…' until a search is attempted.

deduped_findings.title: Hub nav includes many secondary links (Blog, Dashboard, Docs, GitHub) with no visual grouping
deduped_findings.observation: Desktop nav shows: Home, Reader, Search, For You, Sources, Topics, Blog, Dashboard, Docs, GitHub in a single inline list. No separators or grouping between core product links and secondary/docs links.
deduped_findings.impact: Visual noise; primary user actions (Reader, Search, For You) compete with secondary destinations.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Group secondary links (Blog, Docs, GitHub) to the right or in a 'More' menu. Consider moving Dashboard behind auth or to a user menu.

deduped_findings.title: Mobile topic pills are numerous and may require horizontal scroll or wrapping
deduped_findings.observation: On mobile, the home surface shows many topic pills (research 73, blogs 63, open-source 60, …) which wrap into multiple rows, creating a dense band before the main content.
deduped_findings.impact: Users must scroll past a wall of tags before reaching primary actions.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Collapse tags behind a 'Topics (70)' expandable, or show top N and a 'More' affordance on mobile.

deduped_findings.title: For You intentionally empty when BACKEND_URL not configured
deduped_findings.observation: Page renders a clear message 'Recommendations require the optional ai-web-feeds backend service.' with links to /sources and deployment docs. No recommendations list or loading state shown for unauthenticated or unconfigured backend.
deduped_findings.impact: Feature surface is gated; users hitting the link directly may be confused unless they read the message. Not a bug per deployment model.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Ensure the empty state includes a stronger visual cue or CTA to the main reader. Consider hiding 'For You' nav item entirely when backend not configured.

deduped_findings.title: Dashboard lacks site footer consistent with hub surfaces
deduped_findings.observation: Page ends after operations card with no <footer> or secondary links. Matches prior hub observation.
deduped_findings.impact: Inconsistent chrome across surfaces; no copyright or policy links termination.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Add shared footer component to all non-docs routes including dashboard and for-you.

deduped_findings.title: Topics index renders as flat list rows on mobile; no card separation or tap-target affordance
deduped_findings.observation: At 390x844 the /topics page shows a long vertical list of topic rows with subtle dividers. Rows are full-width, flat, without card chrome.
deduped_findings.impact: Slightly reduced perceived interactivity and grouping on mobile discovery. May feel like plain text navigation rather than content collections.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Consider subtle card or surface treatment for topic rows on narrow viewports, or at minimum ensure chevron + count are strongly right-aligned.

deduped_findings.title: All topic cards have uniform visual weight regardless of source count
deduped_findings.observation: On /topics desktop grid, cards for 'Research (73)' and 'Blogs (63)' look identical in size/emphasis to 'Reasoning Models (0)' or 'Fairness (0)'. The only signal is a small secondary badge.
deduped_findings.impact: Users scanning for high-value collections must read numbers rather than perceive density via layout. Popular topics not visually prioritized.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Optional: scale subtle visual weight (padding, border, or badge prominence) for high-count topics, or surface a 'Popular' section.

deduped_findings.title: Mobile post header is minimal and differs from hub/mobile index patterns
deduped_findings.observation: On 390x844 the post page header shows a back arrow button, logo, search icon and chevron, but no full link list or theme toggle affordance in the captured state.
deduped_findings.impact: Small inconsistency in header treatment across blog surfaces on mobile; minor orientation cost.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Align mobile post header treatment with mobile hub/index patterns or document the intentional minimalism.

deduped_findings.title: No RSS/Atom/JSON feed discovery links on individual post pages
deduped_findings.observation: The index page exposes a visible 'RSS' link in the header card pointing to /blog/rss.xml. Individual post pages have no feed links or discovery metadata surfaced in the UI.
deduped_findings.impact: Users who land on a post directly have no in-page cue to subscribe to the blog feed.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Optionally surface a small 'Subscribe' / RSS icon link on post pages, or ensure <link rel="alternate"> tags are present in <head>.

deduped_findings.title: Mobile menu 'Toggle Menu' opens but no strong visual affordance for state or dismiss
deduped_findings.observation: Menu toggles to show full nav items, button shows [expanded]. But no backdrop, X icon change, or tap-outside clear in initial capture.
deduped_findings.impact: Slight discoverability friction on mobile.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Enhance toggle to X on open, add scrim/backdrop, ensure escape key and outside click closes.

deduped_findings.title: Hero uses moderate scale; subhead is lengthy
deduped_findings.observation: H1 reads 'Read AI writing across the open web' at ~text-2xl sm:text-3xl. The subhead paragraph is long and may wrap heavily on constrained viewports.
deduped_findings.impact: Moderate visual hierarchy; could be punchier.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Consider slightly larger hero title or tighter subhead. Test with real content width to ensure no awkward wraps.

deduped_findings.title: Metric grid on dashboard stacks to single column on mobile with compact text
deduped_findings.observation: 4 metric cards (Sources, Verified, Topics, Validation) collapse to vertical stack. Text and progress bars remain readable but dense.
deduped_findings.impact: Usable but may feel cramped on very small viewports; no major breakage.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Consider 2-col explicit or adjust padding for mobile metrics.

deduped_findings.title: Some journeys rely on direct /goto or query params rather than pure UI clicks for entry
deduped_findings.observation: For stability used direct URLs e.g. /search?q=agent, /topics/agents. Pure UI from home via search button was not fully exercised (⌘K or fill).
deduped_findings.impact: Lower coverage of in-app search invocation and query propagation.
deduped_findings.recommendation: In future audits include snapshot after opening search palette and typing query to verify end-to-end.

deduped_findings.title: Search input and 'Search' button have tight padding on mobile; may benefit from larger tap targets
deduped_findings.observation: The search form uses py-2 on input and standard button padding. On 390px in dark, the row is compact; the submit button text 'Search' is short but the overall control height is modest.
deduped_findings.impact: Minor; current targets meet basic usability but are not generous.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Increase min-height to ~44px or add py-2.5/3 on the form row for mobile.

deduped_findings.title: Mobile header + sidebar affordance density on narrow docs pages
deduped_findings.observation: At 390px the top 'AI Web Feeds Open web AI reader' branding + Search + nav links + docs title take space; combined with persistent wide sidebar creates vertical scrolling before content.
deduped_findings.impact: Slight friction on very small screens for docs consumption.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Tighten mobile header (smaller logo/title) or collapse top branding on scroll/doc pages.

blocked_routes: /for-you (requires BACKEND_URL for full personalization; shows intent message)
/reader/article/* (404 on production deep links; article route not wired or corpus missing)
/reader (corpus empty by default; 'Load live sample' required to populate)
passed_highlights: Theme toggles (light/dark/system) are present and functional on hub chrome
Command palette (⌘K) opens and lists routes correctly on hub
Primary CTAs (Open reader, Search, For You, Browse sources, Topics) are present and linked
Dark theme applies across most viewports without obvious contrast breakage (except blog surfaces)
Search page renders input controls and empty-state messaging
Viewport responsive: desktop nav hides mobile toggle; mobile shows Toggle Menu
RSS link present and functional on /blog index (returns valid RSS 2.0)
Post pages render title, date, summary, and body content
Blog index loads and lists seeded posts with titles, summaries, dates
Dashboard renders live catalog stats without errors
J5 theme class persists across goto navigation
env_notes: Production corpus empty by default. 'Load live sample' invokes refreshLatest(true). Shortcuts sheet depends on listReaderShortcuts() and handler wiring via useReaderShortcutHandlers. Article deep link 404 persists from W0-scout. /for-you requires BACKEND_URL. Blog surfaces do not consume theme tokens for dark mode.
